messages:
emily: Quick heads-up — trying to finish ingestion for 'aureus-v2' today. weights are uploaded to S3, tokenizer looks mostly OK but found a weird BOS token mapping. Can legal confirm licensing?

emily: weights location:
```
s3://redwood-models/aureus-v2/weights/
sha256: 3b1f8c9e...
```

matt: thanks — for the tokenizer quirk can you paste the output of a quick encode? I remember aurous forks had a special <s> token.

emily: run I used:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Hello').tokens)"
```
output: ['<s>', 'Hello', '</s>'] — prefix token present.

raj: FYI I've got a config validation PR open that will catch mismatched bos/eos tokens and padding schemes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-model-registry/pull/432 — needs one more review.

claire: tagging legal-bot @legal-bot: what's the model license metadata on this one? any NC/ND clauses? we need to know if we can enable hosted endpoints. :eyes:

legal-bot: License scan complete — model metadata shows source license: CC BY-NC 4.0. This is a non-commercial license.

legal-bot: Summary: CC-BY-NC restricts commercial use. Hosted public API (hosted inference) would be considered commercial distribution of service. Dedicated/private deployments where customers bring their own license could be allowed if contractually explicit. Recommend gating Hosted ingest.

emily: ugh, ok. That means we can't put this on Hosted by default. Is there a lightweight note we should add to the model card?

claire: yes — add explicit "Usage restrictions: Non-commercial only — not available on Hosted. Contact Legal for enterprise exceptions." Also add attribution text per CC-BY requirements. I'll open a model-card PR.

matt: also note: tokenizer prefix token will be normalized by runtime if we set tokenizer.bos_token = '<s>' in the model config. Raj's PR will flag mismatch but we should patch config now to avoid runtime surprises.

raj: I can include an automated config patcher in PR #432 to set bos/eos from tokenizer.json if missing. Will add test.

emily: action items: 1) Claire to open model-card PR with license + attribution + usage restriction (ETA today). 2) Raj to land validation/patcher PR (blocker for serving readiness). 3) Legal to confirm path for enterprise exception (if a customer requests Dedicated/Private). 4) DevEx to mark Hosted as gated in model registry UI.

claire: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-cards/pull/128 — includes attribution snippet and "Hosted gated: true" flag. Please review. :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: Will prepare a short guidance doc for enterprise exceptions (contractual language + KYC checklist). ETA 2 business days.

deploy-bot: reminder — models with usage restrictions will not be auto-deployed to hosted fleet. Manual approve required for dedicated/private.

matt: thanks everyone. Once Raj's validator lands and Claire's card merges, Emily can re-run the onboarding checklist and we can close the gating ticket.

emily: sounds good — ping me for review once PRs are merged. I'll also update the ingest doc with the final weights path and tokenizer note.

claire: +1. Thanks all.

emily: :pray:
